# Master Weapon & Legendary Mod Farming Guide

Maximizing your legendary plan unlocks and acquiring top endgame armor frames.

---

### 🔄 Legendary Scrapping Farm Loops
* **Eviction Notice**: The highest yield event in Fallout 76, spawning up to 20–30 legendary Super Mutants. Tag every mutant to collect 15–25 legendary items per event.
* **Expeditions (The Most Sensational Game)**: Can be completed in under 7 minutes with a solo or duo team, guaranteeing **5 legendary items, 1–2 Legendary Modules, and 20,000 XP** per run.
* **Scrap Strategy**: Scrap all weapons and armor containing desirable 1★ effects (*Quad, Bloodied, Anti-Armor, Overeater's, Unyielding*) and 2★ effects (*Explosive, Rapid, Powered, V.A.T.S. Enhanced*) to unlock their crafting recipes.

---

### 🛡️ Top Endgame Body & Power Armor Frames
1. **Civil Engineer Armor**:
   * Acquired via the *Rose Room / Atlantic City* questline.
   * **Set Bonus**: Grants **+35% weapon durability** to all equipped weapons and 10% chance to inflict 150 fire damage on melee attackers.
2. **Hellcat Power Armor**:
   * Acquired via the *Steel Reign* questline.
   * **Passive Reduction**: Built-in **+12% flat ballistic damage reduction** (2% per piece) on top of the standard 42% Power Armor damage reduction.
3. **Union Power Armor**:
   * Purchased with Stamps from Giuseppe at the Whitespring Resort.
   * **Set Bonus**: **+150 Poison Resistance** and **+75 Carry Weight**.
